summary: drive with velocity command; set linear speed and angular speed for mobile robot, cmd_vel, move forward, arc turn
description: Commands a mobile robot velocity for a bounded duration. Command format: 'velocity <linear_mps> <angular_radps> <duration_s>'. Linear speed is metres per second; angular speed is radians per second. Output confirms command start, active duration, and stop. Report when the velocity command starts, ends, or fails.
